description: Core interfaces, compile-time interpolated string handlers, and types for KetPsi's zero-allocation logging framework. Bypasses standard object arrays and boxing to enable absolute zero-allocation structured logging in high-throughput .NET applications.

A zero-allocation OpenTelemetry (OTLP) log exporter for .NET. Bypasses the official SDK to serialize logs directly into raw Protobuf bytes via a lock-free batcher, delivering 22x faster execution and zero GC pressure for extreme-throughput microservices.

A hyper-optimized, zero-allocation console logger for .NET. Writes structured logs and interpolated strings directly to standard output streams without heap allocations, boxing, or garbage collection overhead.
The LZ4 block format in fully managed C#: no native code, no P/Invoke.
A Zstandard (RFC 8878) decompressor and compressor in fully managed C#: no native code, no P/Invoke.
